text: The Exchange field in indexinfo_database holds full exchange names (e.g. "Tokyo Stock Exchange"), while the Index field in indextrade_database holds index symbols (e.g. "N225", "HSI", "000001.SS").
Joining the two needs each exchange matched to its major index symbol (e.g. Tokyo Stock Exchange to N225, Hong Kong Stock Exchange to HSI).
An exchange's region (Asia, Europe, North America) is not stored and must be inferred from geography (e.g. N225 is in Asia).
An up day is a trading day whose close is above its open; a down day one whose close is below its open.
Average intraday volatility is (High - Low) / Open per day, averaged over the period.
